_comment: FROZEN ability reference bar. Ability damage is a SHARE OF THIS, not of the live reference_monster_curve.json. Keeping the two joined made monster HP a dead lever: refcal raised monster HP to lengthen a fight, every ability's damage rose by the same factor, the fight length did not move, and the curve inflated 2-5x across repeated runs while abilities silently kept pace and basic attacks fell behind. This file is a snapshot of the curve the ABILITY_WEIGHTS were authored against and must NOT be rewritten by refcal. Change it only as a deliberate re-authoring of what 'a power strike is worth a fifth of a monster' means, and re-measure with -- ability_hp afterwards.
